summary: Frontend-only E2E (Playwright, 1366px) of CM Phase A+B with fictional ta_ab_ data in the operator org. PASS: (1) SALE HANDOVER item appears once, with Build quote and Assign… (shared queue); assigning Casey shows the success toast and the select goes away; Build quote opens Build Quote → Auto-quote with the afs-aq-prefill banner 'From equipment sale Q-TA-1 — TA AB Sale Gym: 2 confirmed machine(s) pre-selected.', the banner survives a reload, and Clear removes it (also after a reload). FAIL in (1): the customer select (afs-aq-company) is NOT set to the customer and shows 'Select a customer…'. (2) Coordinator +5% → warning toast 'A 5.0% increase differs from the standard 0.0% — submit it for manager approval.' with a Submit for approval action → 'Submitted for manager approval' → PRICE APPROVAL item. As aftersales, 'Approve 5% & send' issues the renewal (£1,050); a persistent warning toast (duration Infinity) with Copy link appears; the NOT DELIVERED item shows Copy link and Resend. (3) Renewals in progress row status 'Approved — email NOT delivered'; Copy link / Resend / Declined work and the link copies correctly; Declined → 'Declined' and stays after a reload. (4) Coordinator Activate → amber conflict box 'TA-AB-OLD is active until 2026-12-31', with no override controls. Aftersales sees the note input; the button stays disabled until a note is typed; Approve & activate → status Active and exactly 1 contract. (5) MOD rate card: 27 rows show HISTORICAL pills and the 3 POA rows are unchanged; no import was applied. (6) All 9 CM tabs load for the coordinator, CRM loads for cm.sales, scrollWidth is 1366 everywhere (no horizontal scroll), no page errors, and the design looks unchanged.

minor.issue: Retrying an agreement that a manager already activated over a conflict (status activation_attention, contract already exists with a duplicate_check=approved_override step) runs _activation_conflicts again. It blocks the coordinator with the same 409 and raises a new ACTIVATION REVIEW item, so a manager must approve again. No duplicate contract is created (count stays 1). Suggest: when existing_contract exists and the stored activation_steps[0].status == 'approved_override' covering the same conflicts, skip the re-review.

ui_bugs.component: AutoQuoteTab customer select (AftersalesApp.js ~line 980, companies fetched at ~line 870 with GET /crm/v2/companies?limit=200)
ui_bugs.issue: The prefilled customer from the sale handover is not selected: the select shows 'Select a customer…' while companyId and the estate are set (site chip 'TA Main · 2' shows). Root cause: the operator org has 705 crm2_companies; the list is capped at 200 alphabetically, so 'TA AB Sale Gym' is not an <option> and a controlled <select> with an unknown value shows blank. This also means real customers past the first 200 can never be picked in Auto-quote. Fix: when prefill.company_id (or any chosen id) is missing from companies, fetch that company and add it to the options (or use a searchable combobox / server-side search).

ui_bugs.component: Copy link buttons (RenewalsInProgress.js line 42, AftersalesApp.js copyLink line 116 + toast action line 149)
ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard?.writeText() is not awaited or caught. When clipboard permission is denied (iframe, insecure context, headless) it throws an unhandled rejection 'Write permission denied'. In preview this opens the CRA webpack error overlay over the page, which blocks all clicks. The success toast 'Accept link copied' also shows even though nothing was copied. Fix: await it inside try/catch and fall back to a textarea + execCommand('copy') or show the link to copy by hand.

integration_issues.issue: It always shows the success toast 'Resend attempted' and ignores r.data.email_delivered. The Action Centre version shows a warning when delivery still fails, so this one should match. The status cell does stay truthful ('email NOT delivered').
Backend resend returned 200, but no new 'Email still not delivered…' toast was found in the DOM next to the persistent approve toast. Not reproduced a second time; please check once by hand.

There is no success toast after Approve & activate or Activate; the only feedback is the status pill changing to Active. The 'duplicate check' step with status approved_override shows a hollow/neutral icon instead of a reviewed/approved icon.

issues: 'Valid from / to' use the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy, US format) instead of the shadcn calendar / UK format.
Narrow price inputs cut off values (e.g. Grappler '120.93' shows as '120.9').

Two identical 'Warranty alert [T90]: Iso Demo Fitness' items and two identical Iso Demo Fitness warranty-opportunity cards, from duplicate crm2_companies names in the operator org (the companies list also shows duplicates such as 'Bitterne Leisure Centre' ×2). Data hygiene only, not caused by this change.

action_items: HIGH: AutoQuoteTab — make sure the prefilled (and any) customer is selectable: add the missing company to the options or switch to server-side search; the 200-company limit hides customers in a 705-company org.
MEDIUM: Guard every navigator.clipboard.writeText call with await/try-catch and a fallback; don't show 'Accept link copied' when the copy failed.
MINOR: RenewalsInProgress Resend should show a warning when email_delivered is false.
MINOR: activate_agreement retry should respect an existing approved_override instead of asking for a new manager review.
MINOR: Add a success toast after activation and an 'approved' icon for the approved_override duplicate_check step.
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js is 3,020 lines; consider splitting DashboardTab / AutoQuoteTab / AgreementsTab into separate modules.
The renewal contract status becomes 'sent' even when the email failed (renewal_comms_status=approved_not_delivered). Any report or filter keyed on status=='sent' will overstate delivery.
An RPI REVIEW item is still raised for a contract that already has a renewal in progress (TA-AB-PREV), which adds noise.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (27/29 checks; failures: Auto-quote customer select not prefilled; Copy link unhandled clipboard rejection)

seed_data_creation: All ta_ab_ data has been deleted, including the uuid-keyed renewal contract, the agreement-created contract, its service/billing/finance_sync docs, 8 crm2_activities and 3 email_send_events to ta-ren@example.test. _ta_ab_cleanup.py now reports nothing left. mod_sor_rate_card and mod_rate_card_meta were not modified. The renewal draft was prepared with a targeted script (_ta_ab_renewal.py) instead of 'Run scan now', so real org contracts were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The preview date is 2026-11-24. Clear the login rate limit (python tests/_clear_login_ratelimit.py) before every 2–3 logins or /login returns 429. Seed with `PYTHONPATH=/app/backend python tests/_ta_ab_seed.py seed` (this also calls sales-handover as cm-test-admin), then `tests/_ta_ab_renewal.py` (prepares only the ta_ab_prev renewal plus its RENEWAL APPROVAL item), and clean up with `python tests/_ta_ab_cleanup.py go`. Agreements sub-tab: Contracts tab → button named 'Agreements' → [data-testid=afs-ag-row-ta_ab_ag]. Grant clipboard permissions (page.context.grant_permissions) before clicking Copy link, or the CRA overlay blocks the page. Toasts are sonner [data-sonner-toast].
rca of the issue: Auto-quote customer not prefilled: AutoQuoteTab loads GET /crm/v2/companies?limit=200, which returns the first 200 of 705 operator companies sorted A→Z. prefill.company_id='ta_ab_co-s' ('TA AB Sale Gym') is not among them, so the controlled <select value=companyId> has no matching option and shows the placeholder, while companyId state and the estate fetch still work. Reproduce: any customer whose name sorts after the 200th company. Fix: add the missing company to the options or use a search.
